title: V6 Automation
description: Automation for the wod6e system: Alpha 2.0 rules (dice, Hunger dice, Taking Half, Health, Vitae, 10-box Humanity), pays power costs, applies merit and clan-trait bonuses in the roll dialog, notes Maturing, sets up clans, and imports V6 conversion bundles. Unofficial fan-made automation, not affiliated with or endorsed by the publishers of Vampire: The Masquerade.
